payload.question:
"The clarifier reads the owner's words in context and asks every..." changed since you answered "A gap with a recommendable option becomes a flippable assumption; every other gap that changes what gets built is asked, all of them, specific, through the question tool." to "How are the clarifier's gaps handled?". Does your answer still hold for what it says now?

Then: Inside the loop the clarifier reads the owner's words with the agent's last reply, the owner's recent messages and repository facts, and acts only on a change to the system being built. A gap with a better-supported option becomes a labelled, flippable assumption; every gap whose answer changes what gets built is asked in the same turn, specific, with options and a recommendation, through the question tool. The owner never reads the interpretation itself. The owner's answers are logged as their words and never asked again; nothing of the clarifier's self-questioning is recorded.
EX-1: given the agent's last reply listed review findings, when the owner says 'resolve all of the findings using a workflow', then no question asks which findings: the interpretation assumes the findings listed above and the work goes on
EX-2: given the agent diagnosed why the panel does not show, when the owner says 'apply the proposed fixes for this issue', then no question asks which issue
EX-3: given the owner refers to an issue found in another recent chat of the same project, when the clarifier runs, then it reads that chat's last reply and the owner's last messages there, and no question asks which issue
EX-4: given the repository is a git repository, when the clarifier runs, then it never says the folder is not a git repository
EX-5: given the transcript cannot be read, when the clarifier runs, then it runs on the owner's words alone
EX-6: given the conversation was compacted, when the clarifier runs, then the agent's last reply and the compaction summary are given, and the summary is never taken as the owner's words
EX-7: given the owner types '/plumb intent claude plugin update plumb@plumb' or '/plumb intent are there anything to merge on main?', when the clarifier reads it, then it finds no change to the system being built, writes no record and asks nothing
EX-8: given the owner types '/plumb intent make the status line show the branch name', when the clarifier reads it, then a loop opens and its blocking questions, if any, come through the question tool in that turn
EX-9: given a request that maps fully to a confirmed requirement, when the clarifier runs, then no question is asked and the loop goes on
EX-10: given the request "reminders must always arrive instantly", when the clarifier interprets it, then the interpretation carries the assumption "instantly means within a minute" and no question is asked
EX-11: given a request with three open gaps, each with a recommended option, when the clarifier runs, then three labelled assumptions and no question
EX-12: given the request "let users export their data" with format and scope unspecified, and four drafted questions, one answered by a confirmed record and one whose options build the same thing, when the clarifier settles its questions, then exactly the two that change what gets built are asked through the question tool, ranked, with suggested answers and a recommended one; the other gaps are labelled assumptions
EX-13: given the request "never keep anyone's email address, and email them their reminders", when the clarifier runs, then exactly one question is asked through the question tool, since the answer changes what gets built
EX-14: given a request that could change a public interface two ways, neither favoured by any record or the conversation, when the clarifier runs, then one question is asked with both ways and what each costs to undo, through the question tool, or the browser study room when the trade-off needs more study
EX-15: given a request with two or three gaps and no better-supported option for any, when the clarifier returns them, then all are asked with the question tool in the same turn, before building, not one per turn and never on a card; no spec session is offered for the count alone
EX-16: given the agent needs to know now or later, a name, or which of two files the owner meant, when it asks, then the question tool asks it
EX-17: given the owner answers a question with 'whatever works', when the agent reads the answer, then the question is asked again; no option is taken for the owner
EX-18: given the owner answered the clarifier's questions through the question tool, when the loop goes on, then the answers are logged as the owner's words and carried by the interpretation, and nothing asks them again
EX-19: given any clarification, when it ends, then nothing about the clarifier's self-questioning is recorded and nothing waits on it
EX-20: given a question that needs the idea of a confirmed requirement, when it is put to the owner, then it explains that idea in one plain sentence before using it, and names no record id
EX-21: given the interpretation has four will lines, one won't and two assumptions, when the owner is asked the remaining question, then the owner sees the question and its options only, never the will, won't or assumed lines
